A: Close strictly breaks previous 20-bar high/low, excluding current bar. Opposite previous 10-bar channel exits. SL distance 2% and TP distance 4% of signal close, centered on actual next-open fill.
B: EMA20 crosses EMA50: previous <= and current > for LONG, previous >= and current < for SHORT. Opposite crossover exits. SL distance 2% and TP distance 4% of signal close, centered on actual next-open fill.
C: Same Donchian20 breakout, LONG only close>EMA50 and SHORT only close<EMA50. Opposite Donchian10 or loss of close/EMA50 direction exits. Wilder ATR14 at signal close: SL distance 2 ATR, TP distance 4 ATR, centered on next-open fill.
entry: Closed-candle signals can enter only the next candle open. No prior-segment signal enters the next segment. No same-open reversal; while occupied entry signals are ignored. Stop/target exits precede strategy exits.
protection: Reuse app.lab.execution: adverse opening stop gap, target gap capped at target, simultaneous stop/target uses stop; adverse slippage and fees on all fills. No trailing stops.
segments: Separate fresh ledgers for development and test. Force liquidation only at segment final close. August positions may carry into September. No tuning or parameter selection.
sizing: Reuse Lab Decimal fee/slippage-inclusive stop risk, floor quantity to 12 places; minimum of 1% balance risk, 2000 USDT notional and 1x collateral capacity. Round fees upward to 8 places and revalidate risk/notional/balance.
buy_and_hold: Passive LONG at segment first open, exit segment final close. Primary allocation capped at 2000 USDT, secondary classic 10000 USDT allocation. Same fee/slippage; no protective stop or 1% stop-risk constraint, so not risk-equivalent.
